notes.subject: etpela yia ten et
notes.rationale: King's age and length of reign counted: eighteen years, three months.

notes.subject: etpela yia ten et ten
notes.rationale: Translation text repeats the number awkwardly; preferred rendering: 'Yehoyakin i gat etpela yia ten et long taim em i kamap king, na em i king long Yerusalayim tripela mun; na nem bilong mama bilong em i Nekhushta, pikinini meri bilong Elnatan, bilong Yerusalayim.'

notes.subject: בן שמנה עשרה שנה
notes.rationale: Hebrew literally 'son of eighteen years'; rendered as age statement.

translation: Yehoyakin i gat etpela yia ten et ten — pikinini man bilong etpela yia ten et — long taim em i kamap king, na em i king long Yerusalayim tripela mun; na nem bilong mama bilong em i Nekhushta, pikinini meri bilong Elnatan, bilong Yerusalayim.

tokens.gloss: long taim em i kamap king
